authority: Original acceptance IDs and assertion population preserved; current user authorization permits source-review substitution only where explicitly accepted. Review-only and executed evidence are separate.

critical_open_findings.finding: Final 30-minute reference run completed but did not meet all read/error targets.
critical_open_findings.detail: Final run: 44,068 samples / 1,806.8s; read p95 432.3ms (228 read errors), write p95 152.7ms (0 errors), overall error 0.56%; outsider isolation had 29 HTTP 503 responses. Targeted API read p95 <=300ms and errors <1% are not fully met; event-visible <=2s and zero isolation defects are not established. Vitals are a separate esbuild P6 profile, not release Vite performance.

critical_open_findings.finding: 100k replay and gas-cap refusal passed; full-stack RSS and total evidence/dependency disk limits remain unmeasured.
Consistent database restore and current-source encrypted base/WAL scratch recovery passed; continuous 60-second RPO, full app/chain recovery and release RTO remain unproved.
Four-engine route/keyboard/mobile smokes passed, but manual independent wallet replay, native Firefox/WebKit TLS validation and manual WCAG/screen-reader review are incomplete.
Revocation <=5s and healthy-RPC convergence <=120s are not measured.

The 3M outer transaction gas limit was removed in the candidate. Read-only review of the dynamic estimator found a same-chain-ID instance-change TOCTOU after asynchronous wallet operations. The supported-wallet/UI 3-payable A13 flow remains executed-pass. The separate numeric inner estimate <=15M capacity claim remains valid. Full build and 100-item wallet/UI verification remain pending.
critical_open_findings.disposition: candidate dynamic gas fix plus P1 chain-instance TOCTOU; focused tests owner-reported only; do not infer 100-item UI success
